_doc: PINNED DeFiLlama pool identities for the aggressive research panel (ADR-064).
A pin is what makes a yield AUDITABLE. Without it a key is resolved by fuzzy
project/chain/symbol hints with 'best TVL wins', and the identity behind the number can
change between two runs with nothing in the record to show it changed. ADR-064 already paid
for that lesson twice: four STEAKUSDC vaults on Base alone, and a 'pinned' entry that held an
Ethereum contract ADDRESS instead of a DeFiLlama pool UUID and therefore silently resolved by
HOW TO FILL A NULL pool_id (this is the Mac-side operation — no code change needed):
2. find the row: project == <project>, chain == <chain>, symbol == <symbol>
3. copy its "pool" field (a UUID) into pool_id below,
4. record tvl_usd / apy_pct / observed_at AS OBSERVED that day — the pin is a receipt,
A null pool_id is NOT a bug and NOT a placeholder to be guessed. It means nobody in this
repository has ever seen the live payload (egress is blocked in the build environment), so
writing a UUID here from memory would fabricate the very identity the pin exists to prove.
The feed FAILS CLOSED on a null pin: the key is absent from the snapshot, the book fails
closed on it, and the panel says so out loud.
